lit.\"\\u00cdndice did\\u00e1ctico: aumenta: "Didactic index: it increases with relative size and decreases with the effective attraction on the outer electron. It is not an experimental value."
lit.\"Electronegatividad en la escala de Pau: "Electronegativity on the Pauling scale. It increases to the right across a period and upward in a group. The light noble gases (He, Ne, Ar) have no established value."
lit.\"Energ\\u00eda liberada (valor positivo: "Energy released (positive value) when capturing an electron. The general trend increases to the right, but it is irregular; several elements do not form a stable anion and appear with no data."
lit.\"Energía necesaria para retirar el elec: "Energy required to remove the outermost electron from a gaseous atom. It increases to the right and upward, with known irregularities (groups 2–13 and 15–16)."
lit.\"Radio at\\u00f3mico de referencia. Aum: "Reference atomic radius. It increases going down a group and decreases to the right across a period."
lit.\"Radio covalente: tama\\u00f1o aproxima: "Covalent radius: approximate size of the atom when it takes part in a covalent bond."
lit.\"Radio efectivo de Shannon para el ion: "Shannon effective radius for the most common ion in 6-coordination. It depends on the charge and the coordination, so it is not a single absolute value per element; it decreases for cations to the right and increases going down a group."

lit.\u0027Este valor es un índice/modelo did: "This value is a didactic index/model: use it to reason about trends, not as experimental data."
